fixedDecisions.foreignKeys: single column, DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED; actions specified per column
fixedDecisions.identity: Internal generated columns allow fixed explicit seed IDs; native IDs remain separate
fixedDecisions.squadExclusion: All 23 saved player slots, owned and concept. This is explicit local target policy, not a claim about verified native eligibility exceptions.
fixedDecisions.footballerResolution: Use supplied unresolved asset-based candidate groups exactly. Do not research or change them.
fixedDecisions.catalogStatus: Preserve draft/unconfirmed seed status; do not promote to verified/enabled.
fixedDecisions.designsAndPromos: Create tables but seed zero rows.
fixedDecisions.stadiumVenues: 74 venues remain source data only; no fabricated item definitions or venue table in this scope.
fixedDecisions.aliases: No extra alias tables in this scope; supplied migration metadata stays in definition_extensions compatibility payload.
fixedDecisions.tactics: Create supplied typed child structures; no invented setting registry or new setting columns.
fixedDecisions.snapshotRevision: Catalog base rows are immutable in this artifact version, so a snapshot references the immutable seeded definition and revision; future mutable revision history is outside this task.
fixedDecisions.runtimeRules: Do not enforce game application algorithms, rewards, reveal/settlement business logic or slot-lock UI behavior inside this artifact task; those need later runtime integration.
fixedDecisions.upgrade: Do not generate ALTER/backfill SQL or inspect live club state.
